events.title: East Coast Beach Cleanup
events.desc: Help keep our shorelines clean! We'll tackle litter across a 2km stretch of East Coast Park beach. Gloves and bags provided. Great for first-timers — no experience needed.

events.title: Animal Shelter Support Day
events.desc: Spend the morning with dogs and cats awaiting adoption. Activities include walking dogs, grooming cats, and keeping their spaces clean and cheerful.

events.title: Digital Skills for Seniors
events.desc: Teach seniors how to use smartphones for video calls, health apps, and online services. Patient and friendly volunteers encouraged.

events.title: Community Food Distribution
events.desc: Help sort, pack, and distribute food to low-income families and elderly residents. A very hands-on and impactful morning.

events.title: Children's Reading Programme
events.desc: Read aloud to children aged 5–10 and run fun literacy activities. Perfect for those who enjoy working with kids.

events.title: Community Garden Day
events.desc: Maintain the community garden — planting, weeding, and learning about urban farming. A refreshing outdoor activity.

events.title: Elderly Home Visits
events.desc: Visit elderly residents living alone to provide companionship and simple assistance. Warm, friendly volunteers welcome.

events.title: Wildlife Photography Walk
events.desc: Document Singapore's native wildlife to support conservation research. Cameras provided, no prior experience needed.
